learned_C (lc_model.GLT).operator: E_ind(r) = sum_s F_rs(G) Lbar_s with F_r. = pi softmax([l_null, l_rs]); l_rs = log(FF0_rs / pi) + g_phi; linear in radiance, F >= 0, sum F <= pi (passive), zero -> zero, boundary correspondence = receiver port / source patch
learned_C (lc_model.GLT).geometry_encoding: patch tokens (centroid, normal, log area, 6-frequency Fourier position) -> 6-layer transformer (d 128, 4 heads, FF 256); receiver query = port position / normal / Fourier + own-patch latent; pair head 3 x 128 on [query, patch latent, 10 relative-geometry features]
learned_C (lc_model.GLT).candidates: every patch with positive analytic unoccluded FF0 (dense receiver x patch). The predeclared top-k rule (smallest k in {64..256} with >= 99 % coverage) FAILED on 100 training configurations (71 / 84 / 91 / 95 %); positive-FF0 coverage is 99.5 % (min 98.8 %) at 56 % of M per receiver
learned_C (lc_model.GLT).objective: cross-entropy to the 1,024-gather hit distribution over [NULL, patches] (FF0 = 0 mass to NULL); operator supervision, never illumination
learned_C (lc_model.GLT).training: AdamW 3e-4, wd 1e-4, warm-up 1k + cosine, 60,000 steps, 4 configurations x 512 receivers, bf16 autocast, seed 5201; validation every 2k steps (val CE, val relative L2 of E for random smooth fields, unoccluded-prior baseline); checkpoint = best val CE
learned_C (lc_model.GLT).scaling: per geometry O(M^2 d + N M d) - DENSE in receiver x patch: the asymptotic scaling is NOT improved over explicit gathers O(N K log T); per iteration O(N M)
learned_C (lc_model.GLT).assumptions_exclusions: diffuse (cosine-integrated irradiance) transport only - no directional radiance; patch-level source quantization (12.5 cm); Lambertian K; open room (sky = NULL); one material model

arms.ORA: explicit 2,048 gathers (seed A); ORA2 seed B = oracle noise
arms.C0p: explicit patch-level F from 1,024 gathers (isolates patch quantization)

REF: independent path-traced GI at the ports (continuous geometry, exact hit points / sun visibility), 2 x 512 paths, 16 bounces
